استأتيا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْتَيَا (istaʔtayā) /is.taʔ.ta.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# اِسْتَأْتِيَا (istaʔtiyā) /is.taʔ.ti.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
